summary: Iteration 16: Tested (1) homepage 'Copy embed code' snippet for non-paid visitors and (2) /admin/ai-usage token-gated dashboard. All backend endpoints (3 windows + 422/403) pass; all frontend flows (gate, invalid token error, valid-token dashboard mount, all 7 required data-testid cards present, 7/30/90 window refetch, sign-out clearing localStorage) pass. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: EmbedFoundingSnippet hides textarea fallback via absolute positioning inside a non-relative parent — the `absolute -left-[9999px]` classes still work in practice but could be moved into a `position:relative` wrapper for clarity.
AdminAiUsage stores token in plain localStorage which is fine since real auth is backend-side, as the inline comment notes — no concern.
fetchAdminAiUsage passes the token in the query string; backend logs may capture it. Acceptable for an internal admin tool but worth migrating to a header in a future iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new surfaces from iter_16 are stable: homepage embed snippet (data-testid=embed-founding-snippet only renders while founding cohort active) and /admin/ai-usage dashboard (token persisted under localStorage['pp-admin-token']). Backend GET /api/admin/ai-usage shape verified against iter_16 fixtures. Budget currently £3.53/£15 = Healthy. When testing admin page, remember dashboard renders only after first /api/admin/ai-usage 200 — wait_for_selector('[data-testid=admin-budget-card]') after submit.
